d:
Dil Se Re from the iconic Bollywood movie Dil Se.., composed and sung by the legendary A.R. Rahman, with harmony vocals by Anuradha & Anupama and soulful lyrics by Gulzar.
Celebrate 28 Years of Dil Se.. and relive the magic of one of Bollywood’s most unforgettable musical albums.
Song: Dil Se Re
Singer: A.R. Rahman
Harmony: Anuradha & Anupama
Music: A.R. Rahman
Lyrics: Gulzar
Movie: Dil Se..
